scope: Partial native Request Pull fields, histories, Log selection, raw request generation and macOS editor/mail composition handoff. Full application/distribution incomplete.

libgit2_validation_source.note: Exact source helper rejects HEAD and leading dash. Core CLI plus explicit source exclusions approximates remaining libgit2 validation; exhaustive equivalence unproven.

verification.core: 11 focused tests passed: three new RequestPull tests plus MenuIcon, Finder creation and metadata checks. Real published UTF-8 request matches direct Git stdout, Start remotes/ normalization, mixed staged/unstaged and remote refs preserved, End/argument gates, unpublished failure, pre-cancellation, tag and bare-repository generation. RequestPull is routed in the app, has no pinned Finder menu condition, and shares original unified-diff icon.
verification.native: Four-Git real receiver passed absent defaults, branch/remote list, repository-scoped fields/global URL history, End-invalid pre-validation history/last-field saves with no Send Mail save, explicit End/URL overrides, actual source-scoped Log with hidden working rows and select/Cancel callback, captured text/mail and duplicate-submission gates, exact pullrequest.txt bytes, reopened fields/global Send Mail, URL deletion, generation failure, existing document Open fallback callback, real owned wrapper/helper cancellation and fresh-token retry. Local HEAD/index/working bytes and remote refs unchanged. Hidden native RequestPullDialog hosting layout only; no displayed acceptance.
verification.builds: Unsigned final Debug and AppStore builds and bundle audits passed: Finder extension, licenses, EditorConfig/IssueRegex and 98 upstream icons. NOTICE byte-identical in both. Store Git 2.55.0: 11 universal Mach-O files plus local Git fixture operations passed. Source project regenerated to include the two new files.
verification.documentation: Source pin checker and 3277 seven-column inventory rows passed. Six mappings retain partial-native-replacement status. README, Request Pull parity, NOTICE and native CI step updated. Help corrected to verified upstream patch/pull-request manual. Local site build logs recorded separately; unpublished. Screenshots predate new dialog.
verification.processes: Core compiler terminal before Debug, final Debug terminal before native compiler/receiver, receiver terminal before Store. No main GUI, displayed windows, editor or mail launches. Native prohibited activation/private UUID preferences; handoff callbacks inspect documents instead of opening them. Owned documents removed by receivers; wrapper/helper stopped before retry. Four empty owned UUID preference plists removed after termination; zero nonempty changed. Owned app/receiver audit empty.
verification.iterations: First SwiftPM compile failed because the app called internal OperationCancellation.check. Replaced with public isCancelled guard; successful retry and final Debug/native/Store use that fix. Help initially referenced a nonexistent requestpull page; corrected after source/manual inspection, then rebuilt Debug before native testing.
verification.limitations: Physical fields/dropdowns/Shift+Delete/Log sheets/Cancel/Escape/close/default/resize/themes/accessibility, actual editor/mail composer and long-lived file lifecycle, mail To/CC/subject/attachment/combine/SMTP controls, network credential access, CLI endrev/url presets, Push result routing, signed sandbox/Finder/App Store acceptance pending. Native cancellation stops owned process rather than source post-command cancellation check. Validation uses CLI plus source exclusions, not complete libgit2 parity. Full file/dialog/application port and hosted CI/site/distribution incomplete; GitHub authorization unavailable and not retried.
